commit.message: governance: admit SADHANA responsive constellation shell

intent: Admit the minimum shared-shell paths required for a real iPhone-readable SADHANA Constellation. Preserve the existing desktop navigation, add only a bounded mobile navigation seam, and make the actual root layout—not an isolated component harness—the 390px no-horizontal-overflow completion oracle.

honest_blockers: This admission changes no dashboard source, starts no browser or service, and proves no mobile usability.
The current real 390px root-layout observation has document scrollWidth 980px because the 260px desktop sidebar offset remains unconditional.
A component rendered in an isolated browser shell is supporting evidence only and cannot close the real-route mobile gate.
CLAUDE.md and SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md changes are deterministic generated mirrors of ACTIVE_TRACK only; they add no independent authority.
interface_mismatches: The Constellation component is responsive, but the shared root layout reserves 260px at every viewport.
Hiding the desktop sidebar without a bounded mobile navigation path would make the route difficult to recover on an iPhone.
Viewport screenshots alone do not prove absence of off-screen document overflow; the browser oracle must assert scrollWidth against innerWidth.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the admission commit, including deterministic generated track mirrors. No dashboard source, browser state, service, canonical runtime state, or external route is changed by this packet.
